Tommy Turtle Who Kept Falling: Practice Makes Perfect! — Tommy wobbled on his new roller skates and bonked his shell five times! Did he pack up and quit, or try one more time?
Kids science answer for "growth mindset resilience story kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Nobody is born knowing how to ride a bike or draw stars. Falling down is just your brain discovering what to adjust next time.
